Exam authority: part A states the issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-A-01 — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-LIC-D-CLASSC — commercial Class C wording joins alternatives with and (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NC-LIC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-LIC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: office hours and appointment booking (sec01-F03, sec01-F04) are time-variable and must be refreshed from the DMV website.
